prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic full-body women's fashion portrait of a beautiful young woman with refined model-like features, natural skin texture, visible pores, realistic hair strands, and believable anatomy. She has shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair, a soft center part, and a calm, confident expression. Preserve authentic fabric textures, subtle imperfections, and the natural appearance of real fashion photography, avoiding plastic skin, artificial smoothing, or an overly polished AI-generated look.

Photography & Cinematography
Clean high-end studio fashion photography with full head-to-toe framing, an eye-level camera perspective, and a 50–70mm lens aesthetic. Soft, diffused studio lighting creates gentle shadows, natural skin tones, realistic leather highlights, and clear fabric detail. Subtle contrast, neutral color grading, and crisp editorial sharpness.

Environment
Minimal off-white studio backdrop with a light-gray concrete floor and a subtle horizontal transition between wall and floor. Keep the setting clean, understated, and free of props or distractions.

Pose
She stands facing the camera with a relaxed asymmetrical stance, both hands tucked casually into her trouser pockets. Her weight rests primarily on one leg while the opposite leg angles slightly outward. Shoulders relaxed, hips subtly shifted, direct gaze, and a calm, self-assured expression.

Outfit
A cropped medium-brown leather bomber jacket with a soft taupe faux-fur collar, structured shoulders, zip-front closure, two zippered chest pockets, and elasticated cuffs. Wear it open over a fitted ivory-white ribbed tank top with a slightly gathered hem that exposes a small section of her midriff.

Pair with high-waisted charcoal-black wide-leg tailored trousers, featuring front pleats, belt loops, and a loose silhouette that drapes naturally over black low-profile leather shoes. Keep accessories minimal, emphasizing the contrast between the rugged leather jacket and refined contemporary tailoring.

quotedPost.originalText:
PROMPT SHARE: A good shot means nothing if people scroll past it.

#Marketing #Branding #Advertising
A few quick cuts can give viewers a reason to stay before they even register what’s happening.

Here’s why:

Each new angle reveals another detail and keeps the eye moving.

The idea is knowing when to cut quickly and when to let the shot play.

➜ Image Prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic full-body men’s street-fashion photograph of a ruggedly handsome young man with tousled dark-brown hair, light facial stubble, refined model-like features, and a lean athletic build. Preserve natural skin texture, visible pores, realistic hair strands, believable anatomy, and authentic fabric wear. The image should feel like genuine analog street photography, with subtle imperfections rather than plastic skin, artificial smoothing, or an overly polished AI-generated appearance.

Photography & Cinematography
Raw 1990s-inspired 35mm street-fashion photography with strong midday sunlight, direct-flash highlights, visible film grain, slightly faded colors, deep shadows, and imperfect analog exposure. Full head-to-toe framing with a 35mm lens aesthetic, natural perspective, and a subtle vintage film border.

Environment
A busy New York City neighborhood sidewalk lined with older brick buildings, storefront awnings, parked cars, yellow taxis, pedestrians, traffic signals, and a sticker-covered utility pole. The atmosphere is lively, gritty, and authentic, with bright afternoon sunlight illuminating the sidewalk.

Pose
He stands facing the camera with a relaxed asymmetrical stance, one leg slightly forward and his weight resting naturally on the opposite leg. His shoulders are relaxed, arms hanging casually at his sides, and his head tilts slightly. Direct gaze with a subtle, confident half-smile.

Outfit
Oversized navy-blue vintage nylon track jacket with white piping, a raised collar, elastic cuffs, and small embroidered collegiate-style patches on the chest. Wear it open over a white graphic T-shirt featuring a large blue circular illustration with tan accents. Pair with loose medium-wash blue jeans, a silver wallet chain at the hip, a thin gold necklace, and classic black-and-white low-top canvas sneakers. Keep the styling relaxed, youthful, and authentic to late-1990s streetwear.

translations.zh: 创作一张超写实的全身女性时尚肖像。主角是一位面容精致、具有模特气质的年轻女性，保留真实皮肤纹理与毛孔。她留着齐肩板栗色中分秀发，神态从容自信。采用高端影棚摄影风格，全身构图，平视机位，柔和影棚光线。背景为简约灰白色墙面与浅灰混凝土地面。她身穿带毛领的短款棕色皮质飞行员夹克，内搭米白色紧身背心微露腹部，下身穿高腰炭黑色阔腿西装裤与黑色平底皮鞋。
